label: GO step after a rewarded trial, early in the episode, biased to choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 gives 100% recall but 7% precision). It is strongly limited to early episode trials: rate is about 10% in trials 0-9, falls steadily, and is essentially zero after trial 50. It is mostly tied to an upcoming a2 choice (84% of mass; model_act==2 at 4.7x lift), and the policy logit at those steps is moderately to strongly a2 (choice -9 to -4). Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded GO after unrewarded trials and decays over consecutive rewarded a2 trials (e.g. 0.57, 0.28, 0.12, 0.01). It never fires at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or late in an episode. The only FUTURE variable is action, which is the upcoming choice the agent itself computes, so it is legitimate. Without it, the observed-only predicate (GO & prev_reward==1 & ep_trial<30) has dev F1 0.37 and mass recall 0.95. Many early rewarded a2 GO steps stay silent, so precision is incomplete; the feature looks like an early-episode, decaying reward-driven a2 signal whose information is partly in its magnitude.
